name: Aeroplan Card

apr.notes: 19.74% to 28.24% variable APR. APR is Min of (Prime + 12.99%) and 29.99% to Min of (Prime + 21.49%) and 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

base_rate.description: 1X points for each dollar spent on all other purchases. Points do not expire as long as your Aeroplan Credit Card account is open.

categories.label: Dining at restaurants, including takeout and eligible delivery services
Purchases made directly with Air Canada

rewards.redemption_notes: Points can be redeemed for flight rewards through the Aeroplan program. Pay Yourself Back allows redeeming points for statement credit on travel, dining, grocery store and gas station purchases within last 90 days. 500 bonus points for every $2,000 spent in a calendar month, up to 1,500 points per month.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 60,000 bonus points after spending $3,000 on purchases in the first 3 months your account is open.

benefits.title: Aeroplan 25K Status for New Cardmembers
benefits.description: New cardmembers will automatically receive Aeroplan 25K Status for the remainder of the calendar year, plus the following calendar year. Keep your Aeroplan 25K Status with $15,000 in account spend during a calendar year.

benefits.title: Upgrade to Aeroplan 35K Status
benefits.description: Achieve Aeroplan 35K Status after spending $75,000 on purchases made during a calendar year.

benefits.title: Up to 25,000 Status Qualifying Credits (SQC)
benefits.description: Primary Cardmembers can get up to 25,000 Status Qualifying Credits (SQC) each calendar year (5,000 SQC as a bonus, 10,000 SQC with $25,000 in net purchases, and another 10,000 SQC with $50,000 in net purchases on the card account).

benefits.title: Free First Checked Bags
benefits.description: Cardmembers and travel companions (up to eight) traveling on the same reservation will all enjoy free first checked bags (up to 50lb) when travel originates on an Air Canada flight.

benefits.title: Preferred Pricing on Flight Rewards
benefits.description: Receive access to preferred pricing on flight rewards. As the Primary Cardmember, you can often book flight rewards for even fewer points.

benefits.title: Pay Yourself Back
benefits.description: Turn your recent travel, dining, grocery store and gas station purchases into a statement credit. Select eligible transactions that posted to your account within the last 90 days to redeem.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck or NEXUS Fee Credit
benefits.description: Receive a statement credit of up to $120 every 4 years as a reimbursement for the application fee charged to your Aeroplan Card.

benefits.title: Mastercard 24/7 Concierge
benefits.description: Need to locate hard to find items or even reserve that perfect table? Our concierge is there to help. To contact the concierge, call the number on the back of your card.

benefits.title: 10% Bonus on Ultimate Rewards Points Transfers
benefits.description: Chase Aeroplan credit cardmembers get a 10% transfer bonus after transferring 50,000 or more Ultimate Rewards points in a single transaction from an eligible Chase credit card to their Aeroplan account. Maximum of 25,000 Aeroplan bonus points per calendar year.

travel_perks.free_checked_bags: Free first checked bag for cardmember and up to 8 companions on Air Canada flights

notes: Verified from official Chase product page on 2026-07-25.
